svg.text: One palette, one type scale, one set of components across all seven screens.
System UI font. Money uses tabular figures so columns line up.
Every gig funded in this app adds up exactly.
Explains, never blames; offers the next step.
Seen 6 s ago, on a gig
Screens never show database names, codes or raw errors.
Loading, empty, error and content states on every panel.
Short of money → “Top up”. Busy → “Mark completed”.
Every colour comes with a word: badges, map key, star rows.
The night map is the showpiece; everything around it stays quiet.
